UPDATE {{table}}
SET status = CASE
    WHEN total > 1000 THEN 'vip'
    WHEN total > 100 THEN 'regular'
    ELSE 'new'
  END,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE status IS DISTINCT FROM CASE
    WHEN total > 1000 THEN 'vip'
    WHEN total > 100 THEN 'regular'
    ELSE 'new'
  END;
summary_zh: CASE WHEN 條件式批次 UPDATE
